boundaries: Only current arXiv v1 was reviewed for this publication recommendation; later-version numbers 65 endpoints, 7/12 and the v3 third-study total must not be introduced.
GEPA searched system/user instruction text only, four runs, one proposer; no recursion-wide superiority or failure claim.
H3 changes forced termination and total allowance together; not budget-matched causal isolation.
The paper reports prior Longevity row contact and seven recoverable-answer rows excluded; no blanket claim of pristine held-out data.
Repository not public in v1; ancillary files are described by the paper but were not downloaded or independently hash-verified in this subtask.
Freeze time has no independent timestamp. Authors report one stopping-rule waiver and one post-output descriptive-rule interpretation.
Manuscript numbers and wording were checked; raw logs, statistical intervals, binary figures and experiments were not reproduced.

coverage.directly_read: Original v1 abstract; main design, GEPA search space/feedback/selection/frozen reuse, results needed by abstract and retained summaries, exposure, limitations and availability; selected complete tables 2,3,4,10,12,24.

evidence.quote: A harness is everything around a frozen model that changes what it is scored on: the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets, retry rules and parsers.
edited two text components and nothing else: the system prompt
The request parameters (thinking on or off, the token limit, the temperature) belong to the start and were not searched.

The proposer sees a row’s user message, the task model’s output, reasoning and answer, and feedback (correct, incorrect, unparsed, or cut at the token limit); it never sees the gold or a replication or test row.

The selected texts were recorded, with their SHA256, before the harness was run on any replication row. Each was then run on every letter row of the replication and test partitions, on the main server with its start’s request parameters.
the four runs used 6,003 to 6,147 calls
The items are split into search, replication and test partitions (40/20/40)

The analysis rows leave out 147 replication and 371 test rows that the case study had held out and later called, and 7 replication rows whose reference answers could be recovered from an upload made by mistake
H3 therefore supports the combined change and not forced termination alone.
it says nothing about searching the thinking switch, the token limits or retry rules.
The study’s repository is not public at present.
The freeze time is recorded only in the authors’ private repository, in the hash file that the freeze commit adds, and it is not independently timestamped.
Seven replication rows are both in the reading’s sample and among the defect-A rows, and we flagged them and left them out of every analysis, whether or not anyone tried.
so they cover item sampling and not prompt or judge variance
Each oracle constant is chosen once, on the analysis rows of the partition it is scored on

scope_reason: 研究冻结模型周围的提示搜索及 Harness 评估有效性；GEPA 根据执行和可解析反馈改变提示，选中提示冻结并跨 replication/test 样本复用。论文主体是专项评测，不能整体描述为一个新的递归进化算法。

summary_recommendation.summary_en: A preregistered evaluation compares simple configurations around frozen models, a rescue configuration and GEPA-selected prompts to examine whether Harness-search gains come from answer parseability, baseline choice or evaluation defects. Injected-defect comparisons show that replication through the same pipeline can reproduce a defect’s distortion instead of revealing it.
summary_recommendation.summary_zh: 预注册评测比较冻结模型周围的简单配置、救援配置与 GEPA 选出的提示，追查 Harness 搜索增益究竟来自答案可解析性、基线选择还是评测缺陷。注入缺陷的对照显示，使用同一管线进行复制可能复现缺陷的影响，而不能揭示它。

title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
